description: Y13: verification finding IDs (rounds 1–7, plus Z1–Z5 of round 8) -> phase-0 spec gap IDs (G1–G34) or 신규(스펙 외), and the 'Gaps:' line for every commit since WP-A, for the session owner's history rewrite. Round-3 and round-6 N IDs are N3-x / N6-x; round-5 G IDs are V5-G (they collide with the spec's G1–G34). Generated from the round documents (spec/verify_round*.md) and the commit messages.
